overall_reason: The reaction pill grows from half size at its corner on a springy 380 ms curve (cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.35, 0.5, 1)) with a 160 ms fade, a demo showpiece where overshoot fits (C15), but the reaction disappears at about 4 s with no cause shown and returns later.

score.reason: T-PURPOSE and T-CONTINUITY pass for the anchored spring; T-DEMO-LOOP finds a reset with no seen cause.

findings.where: span.dr-pill reaction on the 'Send photos' bubble, 1440
findings.evidence: The reaction shows at 1609 ms and 2612 ms, is gone at 4001 ms and is back at 5511 ms. No still shows a pointer, an undo or any other cause for its removal.
findings.before: The reaction vanishes and returns with no cause
findings.after: Remove the reaction only with a visible cause (a tap on it), or keep it and restart the loop on a calm frame while hidden
findings.why: A reaction that disappears on its own reads as lost data, not as part of the story (MOT-245).

strengths: The pill scales from 0.5 with transform-origin 30% 20%, toward the bubble it belongs to, so it arrives from its anchor; the overshoot sits on a one-off demo beat, not on a control.
not_investigated: Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
